subject: Re: Family reunion, 20 guests, late September
body:
Hi Deniz,

Thank you for thinking of us for your family reunion. A group of this size needs a person to put together the right mix of rooms and a group rate, so our Guest Relations team will personally follow up with you today.
ai_suggested_reply:
Hi Deniz,

Thank you for thinking of us for your family reunion. For a 20-guest group over 21 to 24 September we would put together a mix of Classic and River View rooms and a group rate - let me confirm exact availability and pricing and come back to you within the day.

The Hotel Aurora team
